name: strict-w-controls-full
cmd: bun port-input/run.ts test core/table-admission.test.ts core/count-premise-integration.test.ts core/count-premise-search.test.ts core/evaluation-admission.test.ts core/reader-endpoint.test.ts

name: strict-w-message
cmd: set -euo pipefail; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional >/dev/null); printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs"; for file in port-input/commit-message.txt; do sha256sum "$file"; "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < "$file"; done
